Web VPython 3.2

a = sphere(color = vec(1,0.3,0.2), make_trail = True, pos = vec(0,10,0))
a.v = vec(2,0,0)
a2 = sphere(color = vec(0.3,0.3,0.9), make_trail = True, pos = vec(0,10,0))
a2.v = vec(0,0,0)
b = box(size = vec(40, 1, 20), color = vec(0.2,0.8,0.5))
cnt = 0
while True : # 조건이 참(True)일 동안 반복!
    rate(100) # 1초에 100번 반복
    cnt = cnt + 1
    if cnt % 100 == 0 :
        a.clone()
        a2.clone()
    a.pos = a.pos + 0.01 * a.v
    a2.pos = a2.pos + 0.01 * a2.v
    b.size.x = a.pos.x * 3
    if a.pos.y <= 1.5 :
        a.v.y = -a.v.y
    else :
        a.v.y = a.v.y + 0.01 * -9.8
    if a2.pos.y <= 1.5 :
        a2.v.y = -a2.v.y
    else :
        a2.v.y = a2.v.y + 0.01 * -9.8
